tagline_card.headline: Lottie Word Runner
tagline_card.content: High-performance **speed-reading** tool for Canva that converts text into vector-perfect **Lottie animations**.

extrude_preview.headline: Vector RSVP
extrude_preview.content: Uses **opentype.js** to convert glyphs into shape paths for **infinite scalability**.

inflated_preview.headline: Global Text
inflated_preview.content: Full **Arabic & RTL** support with character reshaping and **BIDI logic**.
